jobs.title: What If Earth Was Hollow?
jobs.description:
Scoop out everything under Earth's thin crust and over 99% of the planet's mass is gone. Gravity would drop so low you'd weigh less than a soda can, and inside the empty shell you'd float. But our air would leak away into space!

#hollowearth #earth #space #science #shorts
